tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List the events booked on one day, one per line as start, duration, and title.

tools.name: book_slot
tools.description: Book a slot (an ISO date-time on a half-hour boundary) under a title for this session.

tools.name: get_slot
tools.description: Read the title booked under a slot in this session.

resources.name: booking hours
resources.text: Bookings are accepted on weekdays between 09:00 and 17:00, on half-hour boundaries, and must not overlap an event already on the day.

prompts.name: schedule
prompts.description: Find a free slot on a day for a titled meeting.
prompts.text: List the events on {{date}}, pick a free slot inside the booking hours, book it as {{title}}, and read the slot back.
